featured_reviews.name: shevanti verma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi Ratnesh Sir,

Thank you so much for arranging the Kothali Peth trekking trip! It was my first trekking experience, and I thoroughly enjoyed it. Meeting new people and making friends was an added bonus.

It was like discovering myself - my limitations, my strengths and personal growth. The trek taught me to break down challenges into smaller steps and push through, even when it gets tough. But reaching the top of the mountain was an incredible feeling, and the sense of accomplishment was overwhelming. All my fears and pain vanished as I took in the breathtaking view from the top. The natural scenery was breathtaking - the lush green forests, fresh air, picturesque villages, and stunning vistas were truly inspiring. The village life and local food were also fantastic. It was a life lesson - to take my time, persevere, and trust the process.

Thanks to Ratnesh sir for guiding me to take small steps and making this trekking so easy. There were many people but you make sure to look after each and everyone and guide them personally.. Now trekking is in my hobby list. I will try to do trekking once in every month.

Thank you Ratnesh sir once again. Your efforts in organizing this trip are truly appreciated.

Best regards,
-Shevanti verma

featured_reviews.name: meghna trivedi
featured_reviews.review_text: My first experience with Indradhanush foundation was the star gazing trip at Dahanu in October and I must say it was an out of the world experience. Ratneshji is a very good host and great at organizing events efficiently and ensuring the all participants children and adults alike have fun. Shri Jatin Rathod sir from the Nehru Planetarium and Shri Rajesh Kacha sir from Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan made the overnight star gazing event an experience which is still freshly etched in my mind. They made us view Jupiter and its 3 moons, Saturn, Andromeda and Milky Way galaxies and many other constellations and satellites. My family and myself were fortunate to benefit from their expertise and the knowledge that they shared about the cosmos stars and planets has really opened the doors of our closed minds to the wonders of the universe. Looking forward to other such trips in the future with Indradhanush Foundation. My best wishes to the entire team always.

name: HUMANITY FOUNDATION
description:
I am Noorullah Mukhtar Khan (Noor Khan), founder of Humanity Foundation, based in Nalasopara, Palghar, Mumbai. My mission is simple, to support those who are struggling and ensure help reaches them when they need it the most.

Through Humanity Foundation, I work to provide medical assistance to patients who cannot afford treatment and distribute ration kits to underprivileged families. During the COVID-19 pandemic, I had the opportunity to support thousands of people in difficult times.

My journey in social work has been recognized with multiple honors, but for me, the real reward is being able to make a difference. No matter the issue, I remain committed to standing by those in need and continuing this work with dedication and compassion.

owner_posts.post_text:
Free Medical Camp in Mumbai

Humanity Foundation successfully organized a Free Medical Camp at D’Monte Park Recreation Club, Bandra West, Mumbai, to provide quality healthcare services to underprivileged and needy individuals.

Experienced specialist doctors offered free consultations, check-ups, and health guidance, helping many local residents benefit from expert medical care.

Under the leadership of Founder Nur Khan, with valuable support from Hasnain Bhai, the camp saw great community participation and appreciation.

Humanity Foundation remains committed to serving society through impactful healthcare and welfare initiatives.

*मानवता की मिसाल – Humanity Foundation का सराहनीय कार्य ❤️*
Humanity Foundation के *Dr. Manish Londhe* sir के सहयोग से एक मासूम बच्चे का फेरी (निःशुल्क) में इलाज शुरू किया गया है। यह पहल न केवल उस बच्चे के लिए नई उम्मीद लेकर आई है, बल्कि समाज में इंसानियत और सेवा भावना का एक बेहतरीन उदाहरण भी पेश करती है।
बच्चे के परिवार वालों ने Humanity Foundation की पूरी टीम और खास तौर पर *Dr. Manish Londhe* sir का तहे दिल से शुक्रिया अदा किया है। उनका कहना है कि इस मदद ने उनके जीवन में एक नई रोशनी दी है।

We have partnered with various schools in Virar and Nalasopara to ensure that timely education is provided to the ones who need it the most. We have a weekend centre at Mulund where we work with dumping ground children. We have supported 3000+ children in Mumbai with basic material aid.
